sentences.en: When you build a home or design a building,
sentences.zh: 当你建造房屋或设计建筑时，

sentences.en: there are many alarms you might want to install.
sentences.zh: 你可能想安装许多警报器。

sentences.en: We have devices that beep and blare when something is wrong.
sentences.zh: 我们有各种装置，在出问题时会发出蜂鸣声和警报声。
它们会通知我们出现了问题。
它们会向我们发出威胁警报。

sentences.en: In the long course of evolution,
nature has built similar alarms into us.
sentences.zh: 大自然也在我们体内内置了类似的警报系统。

sentences.en: Warnings go off inside our heads
sentences.zh: 当我们即将做某件可能有危险的事情时，

sentences.en: when we are about to do something that can be dangerous.
Our internal alarm systems can also get activated
sentences.zh: 我们的内在警报系统也可能被激活，

sentences.en: by situations that are not dangerous but are still stressful,
sentences.zh: 即使是在并不危险但仍有压力的情境下，

sentences.en: like performing at a piano recital or public speaking
sentences.zh: 比如在钢琴独奏会上表演、公开演讲，

sentences.en: or going to a party where we don't know anyone.
sentences.zh: 或者去参加一个谁也不认识的聚会。
不过隔离期间过得还不错吧？

sentences.en: But recently I have been going to dinner again.
sentences.zh: 但最近我又开始出去吃晚餐了。

sentences.en: Did I just say I've been going to dinner again?
sentences.zh: 我刚才是不是说我又开始出去吃晚餐了？

sentences.en: Should I give them more details or should I die?
sentences.zh: 我是该多给他们解释一下，还是干脆找个地缝钻进去？

sentences.en: The paradox, of course, is that the alarms meant to help us
sentences.zh: 当然，悖论在于，这些本意是为了帮助我们的警报，
有时也会让我们失去平衡，
尤其是当它们变得震耳欲聋的时候。

sentences.en: learning to listen differently to the alarms inside your head.
sentences.zh: 学习以不同的方式倾听你脑海中的警报。

sentences.en: Life is full of adversity, challenge, and uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 生活充满了逆境、挑战和不确定性。

sentences.en: Think back to the last time you had a child come to you in tears
sentences.zh: 回想一下，上一次有孩子哭着来找你，

sentences.en: or a friend who had just received a difficult medical diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 或者有朋友刚收到一份棘手的医疗诊断报告时，是什么情景。

sentences.en: Think back to the last time you were worried about something.
sentences.zh: 回想一下，上一次你为某事感到担忧是什么时候。

sentences.en: So worried, you could barely think straight.
sentences.zh: 担忧到几乎无法正常思考。

sentences.en: At City University of New York Hunter College,
sentences.zh: 在纽约城市大学亨特学院，
心理学家兼神经科学家特蕾西·丹尼斯-塔瓦里

sentences.en: studies these voices of alarm inside our heads
sentences.zh: 研究了我们脑海中这些警报的声音，

sentences.en: and how to deal with them.
Tracy Dennis-Tawari, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西·丹尼斯-塔瓦里，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: It's great to be with you.
Tracy, some years ago, you found yourself teaching your son
sentences.zh: 特蕾西，几年前，你曾教你儿子

sentences.en: I understand you were in upstate New York.
sentences.zh: 我听说当时你们在纽约州北部。

sentences.en: Can you describe what the day was like
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下那天的情况，

sentences.en: and your hopes when you set out?
sentences.zh: 以及你出发时的期望吗？

sentences.en: and he was about nine years old at the time.
And we're raising our kids in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 我们在曼哈顿抚养孩子。

sentences.en: And so, you know, he's a city kid
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他是个城市里的孩子，

sentences.en: and we had not gotten around to teaching him how to ride a bike.
sentences.zh: 我们一直没抽出时间教他骑自行车。
当时我们在纽约州北部。

sentences.en: And so I just thought, okay, now is the time.
sentences.zh: 我就想，好吧，现在正是时候。

sentences.en: And I said, okay, Covey, let's go out and start learning.
sentences.zh: 于是我说，好吧，科维，我们出去开始学吧。

sentences.en: And he seemed game for it.
Our friends Raj and Laura had lent us an old Gremlin BMX.
sentences.zh: 我们的朋友拉杰和劳拉借给我们一辆旧的格雷姆林小轮车。

sentences.en: So we had this big old clunky bike.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有这辆又大又笨重的旧自行车。

sentences.en: I took him to a gravelly hill.
sentences.zh: 我带他去了一个满是碎石的小山坡。

sentences.en: And, you know, I just started trying to teach him.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，我就开始尝试教他。

sentences.en: He was riding and he was really doing it.
sentences.zh: 他骑得很好，真的做到了。

sentences.en: But he started to say, you know, I'm afraid.
sentences.zh: 但他开始说，你知道，我很害怕。

sentences.en: And he really wanted to throw in the towel.
So he's staying upright on the bike,
sentences.zh: 所以他虽然在车上保持平衡，

sentences.en: your phone happens to be recording
while you're giving him a pep talk
sentences.zh: 当时你正在对他进行鼓励，

sentences.en: about his ability to ride this bike.
sentences.zh: 谈论他骑这辆车的能力。

sentences.en: Now, it was a windy day,
but I want to hear some of the exchange
sentences.zh: 但我很想听听你们之间的一些对话，

sentences.en: that you had with your son.
sentences.zh: 你和你儿子之间的对话。

sentences.en: And I think it's fair to say that you were frustrated.
sentences.zh: 我想说你当时很沮丧，应该没问题吧。

sentences.en: All right, let's go up, Cubby.
I'm going to start giving up.
I'm doing my best to be supportive
and you're nothing but a grouch.
You're just complaining every second of the way.
sentences.zh: 你只是每时每刻都在抱怨。

sentences.en: Why are you so negative about it?
sentences.zh: 为什么你对此这么消极？

sentences.en: There's nothing to be scared about.
You're just talking yourself into being scared.
And you're just talking yourself into this crazy...
sentences.zh: 而你却在自己吓自己，真是疯了……

sentences.en: You haven't even gotten a single bruise.
I have to give you a little tough love here.
You've got to, like, get your head together.
So, at one point, Tracy, he says, I'm scared.
sentences.zh: 所以，特蕾西，在某个时刻，他说，我很害怕。

sentences.en: And you say, you are not scared.
I want you to put yourself back in your shoes that day.
sentences.zh: 我想让你回到那天，设身处地想一想。

sentences.en: Now, I know you may have revised how you were thinking after you heard this clip.
sentences.zh: 我知道听完这段录音后，你可能已经修正了自己的想法。

sentences.en: But I want you to put yourself back in your shoes that day, in that moment.
sentences.zh: 但我还是想让你回到那天，回到那一刻。

sentences.en: Paint me a picture of how you were trying to help your child deal with his fears.
sentences.zh: 请为我描绘一下，你是如何试图帮助你的孩子应对恐惧的。

sentences.en: And that was very painful to listen to.
sentences.zh: 听这段录音真的很痛苦。

sentences.en: When he was working on riding the bike, it was so puzzling when, in the face of success,
sentences.zh: 当他练习骑车时，最令人困惑的是，明明已经取得了成功，

sentences.en: he kept on expressing fear and anxiety and wasn't able to track the gains he was making.
sentences.zh: 他却一直表达恐惧和焦虑，无法意识到自己取得的进步。

sentences.en: And the more fear and anxiety he expressed, the more anxious I was becoming.
sentences.zh: 他表达的恐惧和焦虑越多，我就变得越焦虑。

sentences.en: And I think I felt like this was a sign that, oh, gosh, is he going to have a hard time persisting through other challenges or things that make him scared?
sentences.zh: 我想我当时觉得这是一个信号，天哪，他以后在面对其他挑战或让他害怕的事情时，是不是也会很难坚持下去？

sentences.en: And so, I think, essentially, I was anxious that his anxiety, learning to ride a bike, was going to reflect or play into some larger vulnerability in his life.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想本质上，我是在焦虑他的焦虑——学骑自行车这件事——会反映或导致他生活中某种更大的脆弱性。

sentences.en: So, like any parent, I felt concerned for his well-being.
sentences.zh: 所以，像任何父母一样，我为他的幸福感到担忧。

sentences.en: And I think that was driving my frustration and my strong reaction to him.
sentences.zh: 我想那正是导致我沮丧以及对他产生强烈反应的原因。

sentences.en: So, as we were researching this episode, we came by the work of the author Julie Lithgott Hames.
sentences.zh: 在研究这一集时，我们发现了作家朱莉·利思戈特-海姆斯的作品。

sentences.en: She's a former dean at Stanford University.
sentences.zh: 她是斯坦福大学的前院长。

sentences.en: And one of her best-selling books is titled How to Raise an Adult, Break Free of the Over-Parenting Trap and Prepare Your Kid for Success.
sentences.zh: 她最畅销的书之一名为《如何培养成年人：摆脱过度养育的陷阱，为孩子的成功做好准备》。
这是她曾经说过的一段话。

sentences.en: If the world is less safe, which it really is not statistically, but even if it was,
sentences.zh: 如果世界变得不那么安全了——虽然从统计学上讲并非如此，但即使真是这样，

sentences.en: don't we need our kids to be stronger and more capable to face what awaits them outside of our homes?
sentences.zh: 难道我们不需要孩子变得更强大、更有能力去面对家门外等待着他们的一切吗？

sentences.en: If things are less safe out there, we need to be raising warriors, not fragile, weak pieces of veal who will be slaughtered by what the world brings to them.
sentences.zh: 如果外面的世界不那么安全，我们需要培养的是战士，而不是脆弱、软弱的小牛肉，等着被世界带来的东西宰割。

sentences.en: So, Tracy, I heard you trying to do this for your son.
sentences.zh: 所以，特蕾西，我听到你试图为你的儿子这样做。

sentences.en: He was telling you that he was scared, and you were telling him, be a warrior.
sentences.zh: 他告诉你他很害怕，而你告诉他，要做个战士。

sentences.en: And those, you know, her words really resonate, I think, with, you know, me thinking back to how I was feeling in that moment.
sentences.zh: 那些，你知道，她的话确实引起了我的共鸣，我想，回想起我当时的感觉。

sentences.en: I think it resonates with many of us parents who see that the world is very different in many ways from the world we grew up in.
sentences.zh: 我想这引起了我们许多家长的共鸣，我们看到世界在许多方面与我们成长时的世界大不相同。

sentences.en: And we're deeply concerned that we can help launch our children into this new world in a way that sets them up for success and happiness and well-being.
sentences.zh: 我们深切地关注着如何帮助我们的孩子进入这个新世界，并以一种能为他们的成功、幸福和健康打下基础的方式。

sentences.en: So this is one way in which our culture recommends dealing with the alarms that go off inside our heads.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我们文化中建议应对脑海中警报的一种方式。

sentences.en: We say, you know, be brave, ignore the alarms, full speed ahead.
sentences.zh: 我们说，你知道，勇敢点，忽略警报，全速前进。

sentences.en: But there's also another way, and you've come by this yourself in your work as a college professor.
sentences.zh: 但还有另一种方式，你在作为大学教授的工作中也发现了这一点。

sentences.en: I understand, Tracy, starting a few years ago, you noticed a change in your students in terms of how they were handling challenging situations.
sentences.zh: 我了解到，特蕾西，从几年前开始，你注意到你的学生在处理挑战性情况时发生了变化。

sentences.en: Can you talk to me about that?
I've been a professor for moving up on 20 years now.
And really, I think it was just maybe over the past five, six, seven years, there seemed to be quite a shift in how students were reacting to challenges.
sentences.zh: 真的，我想可能是在过去五、六、七年里，学生们应对挑战的方式似乎发生了很大的转变。

sentences.en: And especially with our graduate students, and especially in the field of clinical psychology, that is, people who are becoming our future therapists and clinical researchers.
sentences.zh: 特别是在我们的研究生中，尤其是在临床心理学领域，也就是说，那些即将成为我们未来的治疗师和临床研究人员的人。

sentences.en: When I was, you know, getting my degree, there was this idea that, you know, you throw yourself into these challenging situations, whether it's science or therapy.
sentences.zh: 当我获得学位时，有一种观念是，你知道，你要让自己投入到这些充满挑战的情况中，无论是科学研究还是心理治疗。

sentences.en: And you have to push through, and you have to show that there's a level of grit and determination that you can build on and sort of, you know, slowly become a professional.
sentences.zh: 你必须坚持下去，你必须展现出一种可以建立的毅力和决心，然后，你知道，慢慢成为一名专业人士。

sentences.en: And what I noticed in this era of students is there was less belief in their ability to cope with some of these challenges that were being thrown their way.
sentences.zh: 而我在这一代学生身上注意到的是，他们对自己应对这些挑战的能力缺乏信心。

sentences.en: I think you see this trend really being crystallized in the idea of safe spaces.
sentences.zh: 我认为你可以在“安全空间”这个概念中看到这种趋势的真正结晶。

sentences.en: One way that students have tried to create a more comfortable environment for themselves is to really argue that,
sentences.zh: 学生们试图为自己创造更舒适环境的一种方式，就是真正主张，

sentences.en: well, you know, if there's an offensive opinion, if there is an upsetting content, if, you know, we see this on campuses all over the country,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，如果出现了冒犯性的观点，如果出现了令人不安的内容，如果，你知道，我们在全国各地的校园里都看到了这种情况，

sentences.en: that there are speakers who might come to campus and have some, you know, for some really offensive opinions,
sentences.zh: 那就是可能会有演讲者来到校园，持有某些，你知道，确实非常冒犯性的观点，

sentences.en: or there's a very vigorous debate that a speaker or a number of speakers might be taking part in.
sentences.zh: 或者存在一场非常激烈的辩论，而一位或多位演讲者可能会参与其中。

sentences.en: I see students much less prepared or interested or motivated to actually go and take part in these debates,
sentences.zh: 我发现学生们对于真正去参与这些辩论的准备、兴趣或动力都大大降低了，

sentences.en: in these difficult conversations, in these uncomfortable experiences and emotions,
sentences.zh: 对于这些艰难的对话，对于这些令人不适的经历和情绪，

sentences.en: and instead really ask to be shielded and protected from them.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们真的要求被屏蔽和保护，免受这些影响。

sentences.en: At one point, Tracy, I understand that a professor at your university was alleged to have engaged in inappropriate behavior,
sentences.zh: 特蕾西，我了解到你们学校的一位教授曾被指控有不当行为，

sentences.en: Can you tell me what happened and the effect it had on students?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我发生了什么，以及这对学生产生了什么影响吗？

sentences.en: It was a very painful experience for our community,
sentences.zh: 这对我们的社区来说是一次非常痛苦的经历，

sentences.en: and part of the pain of that experience was that there was awareness
sentences.zh: 而这种痛苦的部分原因在于，虽然大家有所察觉，

sentences.en: and there was not enough advocacy and protection of the students.
sentences.zh: 但对学生的倡导和保护却不够。

sentences.en: And one thing that I was, as we were processing this as a community
sentences.zh: 当我们作为一个社区来处理这件事，

sentences.en: and really tried to engage in those conversations,
sentences.zh: 并真正尝试进行那些对话时，

sentences.en: one thing that I noticed that surprised me in some ways
sentences.zh: 我注意到的一件事在某种程度上让我感到惊讶，

sentences.en: is that there were direct requests from some students
sentences.zh: 那就是有一些学生直接提出要求，

sentences.en: to not give them information without first sort of filtering it for them.
sentences.zh: 不要在没有先为他们进行某种过滤的情况下提供信息。

sentences.en: For example, there was an article that was published,
sentences.zh: 例如，曾有一篇文章发表，

sentences.en: and some students felt very let down and unsupported
sentences.zh: 一些学生感到非常失望和缺乏支持，

sentences.en: because we faculty did not tell them that this article was coming out
sentences.zh: 因为我们教职员工没有告诉他们这篇文章即将发布，

sentences.en: or help them process it before they were able to read it themselves.
sentences.zh: 也没有在他们自己阅读之前帮助他们消化这些内容。

sentences.en: And this really struck me because it occurred to me that what students were asking for
sentences.zh: 这真的让我很震惊，因为我意识到学生们所要求的，

sentences.en: was a sort of way of processing emotions
sentences.zh: 是一种处理情绪的方式，

sentences.en: so that they didn't have to actually process it out of the social support net.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就不必在社会支持网络之外去独自消化这些情绪。

sentences.en: It seemed to me that the emotions they might experience
sentences.zh: 在我看来，他们可能在阅读这篇文章，

sentences.en: in reading this article and being exposed to uncomfortable and painful information,
sentences.zh: 并接触到令人不适和痛苦的信息时所经历的情绪，

sentences.en: that they felt that those emotions might do them harm.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这些情绪可能会伤害到他们。

sentences.en: So the students were looking essentially for a trigger warning?
sentences.zh: 所以学生们本质上是在寻找一种“触发预警”？

sentences.en: In a way, it was a trigger warning.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这确实是一种触发预警。

sentences.en: And of course, trigger warnings began as a way to really help folks
sentences.zh: 当然，触发预警最初是为了真正帮助那些，

sentences.en: who were struggling with post-traumatic stress disorder,
sentences.zh: 正在与创伤后应激障碍作斗争的人，

sentences.en: who had a trauma in their paSt.
sentences.zh: 那些过去经历过创伤的人。

sentences.en: And when they were exposed to trauma-related information,
sentences.zh: 当他们接触到与创伤相关的信息时，

sentences.en: the thought was, well, let's give them an opportunity to prepare
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，好吧，让我们给他们一个准备的机会，

sentences.en: and avoid the information if necessary.
sentences.zh: 并在必要时避开这些信息。

sentences.en: But even as her students were asking for safe spaces and trigger warnings,
sentences.zh: 但即使在她的学生要求安全空间和触发预警时，

sentences.en: Tracy had one eye on the scientific research
sentences.zh: 特蕾西也一直关注着关于这些辅助措施效果的科学研究。

sentences.en: on the effects of these accommodations.
sentences.zh: 相关数据仍在收集汇总中，但在2021年的一项研究中，

sentences.en: The data are still coming in, but in one study from 2021,
sentences.zh: 研究人员找来一些人，并要求他们，你知道，

sentences.en: people were brought in and they were asked to, you know,
sentences.zh: 去阅读一个可能对某些人来说，你知道，

sentences.en: actually read about a scenario that may have, you know,
sentences.zh: 具有挑战性，在情感上具有挑战性或令人不安的场景。

sentences.en: been challenging, emotionally challenging or upsetting for some people.
sentences.zh: 其中一半人收到了关于它的触发预警，

sentences.en: And half of that group, they gave a trigger warning about it
sentences.zh: 提醒他们可能会读到一些令他们不安的内容。

sentences.en: that you might be reading about something that will upset you.
sentences.zh: 而另一半人没有收到该预警。

sentences.en: And the other half did not receive that warning.
sentences.zh: 你在该研究中发现的是，收到触发预警的人，

sentences.en: What you found in this study was that people who received the trigger warning
sentences.zh: 实际上表现出了更高水平的焦虑，

sentences.en: actually showed higher levels of anxiety,
sentences.zh: 特别是如果他们持有“情绪会伤害自己”这种信念的话。

sentences.en: especially if they held this belief that emotions can do them harm.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这难道不会引发对触发预警有效性的质疑吗？

sentences.en: I mean, doesn't that raise questions about the efficacy of trigger warnings?

sentences.zh: 而且很有可能，通过提供触发预警，

sentences.en: And there's a very strong possibility that by giving trigger warnings,
sentences.zh: 我们实际上向人们传递的信息是：

sentences.en: the message we're actually sending to people is that
sentences.zh: 有令人不安的事情要发生了。
我们认为你未必能应付得了。

sentences.en: We don't think you can necessarily handle it.
sentences.zh: 如果你感到难受，这些情绪可能会伤害你。

sentences.en: And if you feel difficult emotions, they might do you harm.
sentences.zh: 所以，触发预警这一事实本身就创造了这种叙事，

sentences.en: So that the very fact of trigger warnings is creating this narrative,
sentences.zh: 围绕着困难情绪的这种说法，大多数情绪科学，

sentences.en: this story around difficult emotions that most emotion science
